arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Data from Treasury Bulletin weekly series (Table AY-1)
# First available week in February 1970
feb_first = 6.71

# Last available week in April 1970
apr_last = 6.69

# First available week in July 1970
jul_first = 6.73

# Last available week in September 1970
sep_last = 6.52

# Absolute percentage change from Feb to Apr: (Apr - Feb) / Feb * 100
pct_change_feb_apr = abs((apr_last - feb_first) / feb_first * 100)
print(f'Feb 6 value: {feb_first}')
print(f'Apr 24 value: {apr_last}')
print(f'Absolute % change (Feb->Apr): {pct_change_feb_apr}')

# Absolute percentage change from Jul to Sep: (Sep - Jul) / Jul * 100
pct_change_jul_sep = abs((sep_last - jul_first) / jul_first * 100)
print(f'July 3 value: {jul_first}')
print(f'Sep 25 value: {sep_last}')
print(f'Absolute % change (Jul->Sep): {pct_change_jul_sep}')

# Ratio of the two percentage changes
ratio = pct_change_feb_apr / pct_change_jul_sep
print(f'Ratio: {ratio}')
print(f'Ratio rounded to 1 decimal: {round(ratio, 1)}')
"
